g.text: S04-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Identity verified first; DDD unknown aud becomes 401 TOKEN_INVALID, not 404.
S04-ddd-policy-sequence expands api → fresh/stableApi version bracket
Only HTTP 200 with matching operationId and non-null allowed is interpretable.
Gateway does NOT invent course success audit or course Service methods.
